senses: to call, call out, recite, read, cry out, proclaim
to call, cry, utter a loud sound
to call unto, cry (for help), call (with name of God)
to read aloud, read (to oneself), read
to summon, invite, call for, call and commission, appoint, call and endow
to call, name, give name to, call by
to be called, be proclaimed, be read aloud, be summoned, be named
(Pual) to be called, be named, be called out, be chosen

strongs.def: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
strongs.kjv: bewray (self), that are bidden, call (for, forth, self, upon), cry (unto), (be) famous, guest, invite, mention, (give) name, preach, (make) proclaim(-ation), pronounce, publish, read, renowned, say
strongs.from: a primitive root (rather identical with H7122 (קָרָא) through the idea of accosting a person met)
